notes: Small changes to the shared controls.
Small look and feel updates.
Small changes to the shared controls.
Titles show an edge when you point at them.
Small changes to the shared controls.
The search field, empty list and buttons look like the rest of Tavora.
New hover rows in the shared controls.
The toolbars, the link bar and the picture bar are one Tab stop each, and the arrow keys move along them. The link and picture bars take your style's look.
The shared controls gained cards and checkbox rows.
Dialogs come in four set widths, so they line up everywhere.
Tabs have more room above and below the text.
The format buttons and the pin show clearly when they're on, and buttons, fields and lists line up at the same heights.
Disabled controls all fade the same way, and empty charts say there's no data yet.
Small fixes in the shared controls.
Lists you pick from with a search show it as a field of its own.
Choose file in the image menu no longer ends in ….
Buttons in the shared controls can say how it went: Copied, Saved, or a spinner while they work.
New stat tiles, fact lists and bar charts in the shared controls.
Menus: rows follow the menu's rounded corners, and in Liquid Glass the row you point at is easy to see.
Built with the newer shared controls. Nothing changes for you.
New hover card in the shared controls.
New tree view in the shared controls.
Built with the newer shared controls. Nothing changes for you.
Tooltips fade out when they close.
Coloured chips get a coloured edge in the Hardware style.
Dragging the sidebar edge or a picture's corner and getting interrupted puts it back.
Panel settings a newer version added stay.
Built with the newer shared controls. Nothing changes for you.
The shared list with search shows its no-match note in a frame.
Small fixes in the shared controls.
A new list with search in the shared controls.
New chips and a tag field in the shared controls.
Save in the link dialog is plain text now, without an icon.
Built with the newer shared controls. Nothing changes for you.
A new calendar in the shared controls.
New text link and list row in the shared controls.
New table options in the shared controls.
New item card pieces in the shared controls.
Built with the newer SDK. Nothing changes for you.
New tooltip pieces in the shared controls.
Each delete or clear gets its own Undo, and Ctrl+Z outside the editor takes it back.
Undo of Clear scratchpad no longer writes over what you typed since.
Renaming or pinning a note another panel just deleted no longer saves it blank.
Escape while typing with an input method no longer drops a new name or clears the search.
A font or size a newer version added stays when you change the other one.
A new note with only a title or a picture stays when you leave it.
Links with a port, like localhost:3000, work.
The Open link hint shows Strg+Klick in German.
The order of your notes keeps what a newer version saved.
Messages are easy to read again in the Liquid Glass style.
A switched-off button no longer blocks the arrow keys.
Shortcut keys in tooltips are a little bigger.
Undo right after opening another note no longer brings back the last note's text.
Your notes keep what a newer version saved.
Tidied up inside. Nothing looks or works differently.
Pasting something you copied on the whiteboard adds its pictures, instead of a wall of code.
Very long text pastes at once, and a note with a lot of text no longer freezes while you type.
When a note gets too big to save, it says so, and keeps what was saved before.
In Hardware, names keep their case and you can see keyboard focus on switches and number fields.
Pasting from Excel or Word keeps the text instead of only a picture.
Yesterday is right on the days the clocks change.
Clear and Remove picture are red, like the other actions that remove things.
Hardware and Liquid Glass look cleaner: clearer fields, softer edges in Liquid Glass dark, calmer badges and disabled buttons in Hardware.
Follows the style you pick in Settings > Appearance.
A note's title or first line that doesn't fit shows in full when you point at it.
Updated parts under the hood.
Updated parts under the hood.
Small fixes under the hood.
Small fixes: clearer messages, German numbers written the German way and better screen reader labels.
Icons all have the same line weight.
Titles break more evenly, and buttons with an icon look better balanced.
The Inter font for notes is now called Tavora font.
Deleting a note moves the focus to the next note, not off the list; Undo gives it back.
Under the hood: newer libraries.
Dragging notes no longer swaps them back and forth under the pointer.
Loads a little lighter: the app keeps only the Latin letters of its fonts.
Dialogs you open with the keyboard appear instantly.
Toasts wait while the panel is hidden or the game is in front, and slide in and out from their edge.
Screen readers read each message once.
Main buttons and badges can follow a theme's deeper button colour.
Small update to the shared look; nothing changes for you here.
Lists, dialogs and settings pages move smoothly.
Small fades and menus follow the shared timing.
Notes lift when you drag them, the others slide out of the way, and the note settles into its place.
Buttons have a little depth and feel pressed when you click them.
Checkboxes, toggles and options animate when you pick them, and folding sections open smoothly.
The link dialog has an icon and a Close button in the corner, and it spaces things out more.
Menus and tooltips open out of the spot they belong to, and buttons dip a little when you press them.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
